gloss: respectfully (formal letter opening); Dear Sir or Madam

definitions.gloss: respectfully; with great respect (formal letter opening)
definitions.explanation: A highly formal opening phrase used at the beginning of a letter. Literally means 'I respectfully state.' Always paired with the closing {敬白|けいはく}.

examples.japanese: {謹啓|きんけい}　{時下|じか}⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: Dear Sir/Madam, I trust you are enjoying continued prosperity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{謹啓|きんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{謹啓|きんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}き{始|はじ}める→書き始める：22272_kakihajimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It is standard to begin wedding invitations with 'kinkei.'

notes:
The most formal of the standard letter-opening phrases. Composed of {謹|きん} (respectfully) and {啓|けい} (to state, to inform). Used in highly formal contexts such as wedding invitations, corporate announcements, and official correspondence. Must be paired with the closing ⟦{敬白|けいはく}→敬白：22308_keihaku⟧.

LETTER OPENING/CLOSING PAIRS (by formality):
- {前略|ぜんりゃく} / {草々|そうそう}: informal
- ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧ / ⟦{敬具|けいぐ}→敬具：12977_keigu⟧: standard formal
- {謹啓|きんけい} / ⟦{敬白|けいはく}→敬白：22308_keihaku⟧: highly formal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧: Dear Sir/Madam — the standard formal opening; less formal than {謹啓|きんけい}
- {前略|ぜんりゃく}: (dispensing with formalities) — a casual opening that skips the seasonal greeting
- ⟦{敬白|けいはく}→敬白：22308_keihaku⟧: respectfully yours — the corresponding closing for {謹啓|きんけい}
